notes.title: Odium to the Core Soundtrack on Spotify
notes.notes:
One month has passed since we released the Odium to the Core soundtrack on YouTube, leaving a promise to expanding to other platforms. Well, now we're available on Spotify!

You can find the entire OST album right here: https://open.spotify.com/album/7BdPfNbpO245MrBwN9ZFwl?si=iJXEZjenTP2hQwDapXqlKA

Additionally you can find the tracks on Amazon Music, YouTube Music, TikTok, Deezer, Shazam, Google Play and Apple Music. So, yeah that's pretty much everywhere. 

Many thanks to the guys who contributed in the making of these tracks. and we hope that they'll find a nice spot in your playlist.

Cheers!

P.S.: While we're talking news and updates, check out the updates on Skopje's Store Page. Our talented art department (it's an epic one-man unit), reworked the entire About section and gave a whole new visual description of the game. You can admire his work here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1211980/Skopje/

notes.title: Odium to the Core Soundtrack
notes.notes:
It’s been pretty quiet here for some time now, so raise the volume to a hundred, because the Odium to the Core soundtrack is now available! Jump into the music that have been keeping you at the edge of your seat. The music was composed by Nemorosus and Krunislav Cvetkovski.

All of the tracks have been uploaded to the Dark-1 YouTube channel here: 
https://www.youtube.com/dark1games

We’re working towards releasing the tracks to Spotify and to Steam as purchasable official game soundtracks, if you’re willing to support the official release. 

Welp, that's pretty much the big news for now, but do stick around as more stuff is coming soon™.

Cheers,
Dark-1

We are proud to announce our Halloween update!
This update comes with many fixes and new features, including time limited Halloween decorations across all levels.

[b]ENDLESS MODE[/b]
For the ones that want a never-ending challenge we added a new mode! Now you can get lost in the world of Odium to the core in the Endless mode. It is a procedurally generated level to test your skills, and challenge your mind.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - New languages! New skins!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32359423/433d8a4734307252994bebd7f39434470ee19655.png[/img]
A new update is here with some new content!
New stuff:
[list]
[*]New Languages: Swedish, French and Chinese are now available! Set your desired language in the options menu.
[*]Clear data: For all of you that want to start with a clean slate. You can find this option in the Extras menu.
[*]New Skins: 2 new cool skins have been added and they are unlocked by default. Fire up the game to check them out in the Extras menu.
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed "Crown of Hate achievement"
[*]Potential fix for users encountering the rare issue of having multiple menus on top of each other. Let us know if you still have issues in the discussion board.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.13
notes.notes:
Patch notes:

Added visual information in the pause menu that shows the collectable status for the current level.


Fixes:

-Fixed the coin UI showing in Nightmare levels
-Fixed a bug where you could play Nightmare without unlocking the level first
-Fixed the boss colliders in Return Null
-Fixed the extra coins that could not be collected in level Backdoor and System Spikes
-Fixes to the last level boss animations
-Fixes to the gravity switch in some levels
-Overall fixes and tweaks
